### Reproducible example

<!--
Your model and DHARMa code as a minimal reproducible example that runs as is in a fresh R session. If possible, use data that everyone can access: a dataset that comes with R or a package (e.g., `data(mtcars)`), simulated data (e.g., with `DHARMa::createData()`), or a small or randomized part of your data pasted into the example with `dput(head(myData, 30))`. If you do not want to share your data in public, create the example in public and send the data privately by e-mail (run `maintainer("DHARMa")` in R to get the address). See [How to make a great R reproducible example](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/5963269/how-to-make-a-great-r-reproducible-example) and the [reprex](https://cran.r-project.org/package=reprex) package. Problem reports without a reproducible example may be closed.
-->
